name: VinylPod
author: maiosx
description: A floating click-wheel/turntable now-playing widget for Spotify — the wheel spins as a record with the album art as its label, and transport controls fade in over it on hover.

panel.description: A small floating iPod-style now-playing panel. The click wheel is a spinning record synced to playback; hover it to reveal prev/play-pause/next.

schema.label: Keep the panel on screen when Spotify isn't running
schema.description: Off hides the whole panel until a track is live.
